intent: A barbarian trophy set: a horned beast-skull helm over smoked hide, a broad wolf-fur mantle and bleached bone trophies, reading from the high camera as pale skull and bone against dark furred hide.
requests: A matte fur material: Fabric reads flat on the mane, mantle and pelt, so the shaggy silhouette has to come from geometry.
A bone colour that reads pale like the fen bone but without Marble's slight sheen; the trophies are the set's signature at the high camera.
